# Media Puppies

> Paid media team for agencies and businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada and Australia.
> We run Google Ads and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads as a white label partner for marketing agencies,
> and as a dedicated media buyer for brands. The team is based in Noida, India, so account work and
> reporting happen while US and UK clients sleep. Month to month, no lock-in, never a percentage of ad spend.

Updated 2026-10-27. 219 articles, 28 free calculators, 70 service and market pages.

## Key facts

- Services: white label PPC and paid social for agencies; dedicated media buyer; Google Ads; Meta ads; LinkedIn ads; SEO; AI automation.
- Markets served: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, United Arab Emirates and India.
- Team location: Noida, Delhi NCR, India. Invoiced to clients in their own currency.
- Pricing model: a fixed monthly fee per account, month to month. Never a percentage of ad spend. The fee depends on the account and is given on the first call, after an audit.
- White label terms: mutual NDA and non-solicit before access; the end client's ad accounts stay in the client's name; reporting in the agency's own template.
- First step for a new account: a written audit within two working days of access.
- Contact: info@mediapuppies.com

## For agencies (white label)

- [White Label PPC Agency: Google & Meta Ads](https://mediapuppies.com/white-label-ppc-agency/): White label PPC for agencies in the US, UK and Australia: Google Ads and Facebook ads run under your brand, reported in your template. Start with one account.
- [Agency Partner Program](https://mediapuppies.com/agency-partner-program/): Two ways for agencies to work with us: refer paid media for a commission, or white label it and keep the client. Mutual NDA, no exclusivity.

## For businesses

- [PPC Management Services: Google, Meta & LinkedIn Ads](https://mediapuppies.com/ppc-management/): PPC management services for US, UK and Australian businesses: Google Ads, Meta and LinkedIn managed daily and reported in cost per customer. Month to month.
- [Hire a Dedicated Media Buyer](https://mediapuppies.com/hire-a-media-buyer/): A named, senior Meta and Google media buyer working inside your team and your Slack, on a monthly fee. No recruitment, no payroll, no notice period.
- [Google Ads Management Services](https://mediapuppies.com/google-ads-agency/): Google Ads management services for US, UK and Australian businesses: Search, Shopping, Performance Max and YouTube, managed daily by a senior team.
- [Meta Ads Agency](https://mediapuppies.com/meta-ads-agency/): Facebook and Instagram advertising managed daily. Advantage+, Conversions API, creative testing and zero account bans in eight years.
- [LinkedIn Ads Agency](https://mediapuppies.com/linkedin-ads-agency/): LinkedIn advertising for B2B brands with high contract values. Account-based targeting, Conversions API, and when LinkedIn is too expensive.
- [Ecommerce PPC Agency](https://mediapuppies.com/ecommerce-ppc-agency/): Meta and Google Shopping management for ecommerce brands, reported on contribution margin and blended MER rather than platform-reported ROAS.
- [SaaS Performance Marketing Agency](https://mediapuppies.com/saas-performance-marketing-agency/): Paid acquisition for B2B and product-led SaaS. Optimised to qualified pipeline and payback period using offline conversion import, not to form fills.
- [B2B Lead Generation Agency](https://mediapuppies.com/b2b-lead-generation-agency/): B2B paid media that is judged on qualified pipeline, not form fills. Google search, LinkedIn and Meta, with CRM outcomes fed back into the bidding.
- [Home Services Lead Generation](https://mediapuppies.com/home-services-lead-generation/): Paid media for home services: HVAC, roofing, plumbing, solar, remodelling. Call tracking, service-area structure and Local Services Ads, judged on booked jobs.
- [Performance Marketing Agency in India](https://mediapuppies.com/performance-marketing/): Performance marketing agency in India running Meta and Google ads for D2C brands and lead-gen businesses, reported in cost per customer. Month to month.

## By market

- [Performance Marketing Agency for US Brands](https://mediapuppies.com/performance-marketing-agency-usa/): An India-based media buying team running Meta and Google ads for US and Canadian brands. Working US hours, invoiced in dollars, reported in cost per customer.
- [Performance Marketing Agency for UK Brands](https://mediapuppies.com/performance-marketing-agency-uk/): Performance marketing and Google Ads agency for UK brands: an India-based team running Google and Meta ads in London hours, invoiced in pounds, CAP Code aware.
- [Performance Marketing Agency for Australian Brands](https://mediapuppies.com/performance-marketing-agency-australia/): Meta and Google ads for Australian brands, run from India with a morning overlap to Sydney. TGA and ACL aware, invoiced in Australian dollars.
- [Performance Marketing Agency for Dubai & UAE](https://mediapuppies.com/performance-marketing-agency-dubai/): Meta and Google ads for Dubai and Abu Dhabi businesses. Trakheesi-aware real estate campaigns, Arabic and English creative, invoiced in dirhams.

## Reading for US, UK, Canadian and Australian buyers

- [White label PPC: how it actually works, and where it goes wrong](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/white-label-ppc-how-it-works/): How white label PPC works: what an agency gets when it outsources media buying, what stays with it, and the four questions worth asking a partner first.
- [White label Facebook ads: how agencies resell Meta ads without the headaches](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/white-label-facebook-ads/): White label Facebook ads let an agency sell Meta advertising under its own brand while a partner runs the accounts. How it works, pricing models and the risks.
- [Eight questions to ask a white label partner before you send an account](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/white-label-partner-questions/): Eight questions for a white label partner before you send the first account: staffing, scope, reporting, pricing, and what they will refuse to do.
- [White label PPC pricing: how partners bill and where the margin goes](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/white-label-ppc-pricing/): White label PPC pricing comes in three shapes, each changing who carries the risk. How partners bill, what is excluded, and how to price it on to clients.
- [White label reporting: how to build white label reports clients trust](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/white-label-reporting/): White label reporting explained: what belongs in white label reports, a monthly workflow, the best tools, where reports leak and who writes the commentary.
- [Outsource PPC management: when it makes sense and how to do it safely](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/outsource-ppc-management/): When to outsource PPC, what an outsourced PPC team should handle, how to compare agencies, freelancers and offshore teams, and how to keep control.
- [How to outsource digital marketing without losing control of it](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/outsource-digital-marketing/): How to outsource digital marketing: which parts to hand over, which to keep in-house, how to choose a partner, and how to run it so results stay visible.
- [Building an offshore marketing team: agency, dedicated hire or staff augmentation](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/offshore-marketing-team/): An offshore marketing team adds senior skills at a different cost base. The three ways to build one, roles to start with, and managing across time zones.
- [Working with an offshore media buyer: the only number that matters](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/offshore-media-buyer-overlap/): Hiring an offshore media buyer: the overlap hours that decide whether it works, what each band feels like, and what to ask before you commit.
- [When an agency should outsource media buying instead of hiring](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/when-to-outsource-media-buying/): When to outsource media buying rather than hire: the arithmetic that decides it, the four signals you have already waited too long, and the option nobody takes.
- [Hiring an Indian marketing agency from the US: what changes](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/indian-marketing-agency-us/): What a US business should settle before hiring an Indian marketing agency: the overlap problem, special ad categories, privacy law, contracts and payment.
- [Hiring an Indian marketing agency from the UK: how it actually works](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/indian-marketing-agency-uk/): What changes when a UK business hires an Indian marketing agency — overlap hours, contracts, payment, data protection, and the regulatory knowledge to test for.
- [Paying an Indian agency from overseas: invoices, FX and tax](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/paying-an-indian-agency/): The mechanics of paying an Indian agency from abroad: invoicing currency, GST on exported services, transfer routes, and who absorbs the bank fees.
- [Planning for Q4 in the US: what actually happens to costs](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/us-q4-ad-costs-planning/): Q4 ad costs in the US climb from October, peak around Black Friday and Cyber Monday, and fall in January. How to budget for it rather than react.
- [Why your US conversions fell and nobody changed anything](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/us-state-privacy-consent-conversions/): US state privacy laws, Global Privacy Control and consent mode quietly cut the conversion data reaching Meta and Google. How to tell if it is you.
- [Lead forms that will actually be followed up: US consent wording](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/us-lead-form-consent-language/): If your US leads will be called or texted, the lead form consent wording next to the submit button matters. What belongs on it, and who writes it.
- [Special Ad Categories: why your US targeting disappeared](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/meta-special-ad-categories-us/): Housing, employment, credit and social issues strip most Meta targeting in the US. What special ad categories remove, what stays, and how to adapt.
- [Local Services Ads: the US listing above your search ads](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/google-local-services-ads-us/): How Google Local Services Ads work for US home services firms, what verification involves, and why the lead dispute process is where the value sits.
- [PECR, consent mode, and the UK conversions you stopped seeing](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/uk-consent-mode-conversion-loss/): UK cookie consent is governed by PECR, and how consent mode is wired decides how much data reaches Meta and Google. How to diagnose a sudden drop.
- [The UK retail calendar: planning around Black Friday and Boxing Day](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/uk-retail-seasonality-planning/): UK retail seasonality has two peaks rather than one, and January behaves differently here than elsewhere. How to budget for the real shape of the year.
- [Financial promotions in the UK: the rule that stops campaigns dead](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/fca-financial-promotions-paid-media/): Promoting an investment, credit product or crypto to UK consumers means the financial promotions rules apply. What that does to a paid media plan.
- [Advertising in Canada: what Indian export brands should know](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/advertising-in-canada/): Advertising in Canada looks like the US and is not. Bilingual requirements, anti-spam law, provincial privacy rules and a thinner auction all change the plan.
- [Why 30 June is Australia’s biggest month and your calendar missed it](https://mediapuppies.com/blog/australia-eofy-marketing/): EOFY marketing in Australia: why the run-up to 30 June is a real demand spike for anything a business can expense, and how to plan ads around it.
